title: HTTP runtime reply
responsibility: Rejects unsupported methods and invalid JSON before invoking a served unit.

inputs.name: runtimeReply.runtime
inputs.description: Runtime to invoke after HTTP admission.

inputs.name: runtimeReply.method
inputs.description: HTTP method, accepted only when exactly POST.

inputs.name: runtimeReply.read
inputs.description: Async body-text reader, called only for POST requests.

outputs.name: runtimeReply
outputs.description: 405 invalid-request for other methods, 400 invalid-json for unreadable/malformed/nonportable input, otherwise 200 with the runtime’s own response, including application failure envelopes.
